terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.body:
1. About These Terms

These Terms & Conditions ("Terms") govern your use of JUM ("Just U And Me", "JUM", "we", "us") and any voice session you book through this website. By booking a session, you agree to these Terms in full.

2. Eligibility

JUM is available only to individuals aged 18 and above. By booking a session, you confirm that you meet this requirement. JUM does not knowingly provide sessions to anyone under 18.

3. What JUM Is — and Is Not

JUM is a listening service. A dedicated listener gives you time and space to talk, at your own pace, about whatever you choose to share.

JUM is not medical care, mental-health therapy or counselling, nutrition or clinical advice, legal or business advice, relationship or political advice, or an emergency or crisis service. Nothing said during a session is a diagnosis, a treatment plan, or professional advice of any kind. JUM listeners do not offer unsolicited advice or solutions unless you specifically ask for their personal perspective.

4. How Sessions Work

You choose an available date and time from the calendar (shown in India Standard Time, IST, regardless of where you are booking from), a session length, and a calling platform. Submitting a request does not confirm your session — JUM reviews each request and either confirms or declines it, typically within the response window shown on screen. Confirmed sessions require payment before joining details are sent.

5. Calling Platforms

You may join your session using JUM's own calling tool, Google Meet, Zoom, or Microsoft Teams. Only JUM's own calling tool supports extending a session while it is already in progress; sessions booked on a third-party platform cannot be extended mid-call.

6. During Your Session

Sessions are a space for you to talk. We ask that you engage respectfully — abusive, threatening, or harassing behaviour toward a JUM listener is not permitted and may result in the session being ended early and future bookings being declined. A listener may also end a session early if they believe continuing would be unsafe or inappropriate.

7. Recording & Confidentiality

JUM does not intentionally record standard listening sessions. What you share in a session is treated as confidential by JUM and is not shared with third parties, except where we are required to do so by law, or where we reasonably believe disclosure is necessary to protect someone's safety.

8. Using a Nickname — or Sharing Your Real Information

You are not required to use your real name when booking. A nickname is entirely acceptable — share only what you're comfortable sharing.

If you would rather share your real name or other identifying details, you may choose to do so at booking. This is entirely your choice. JUM is not responsible for, and does not verify, any information — real or otherwise — that you choose to provide.

9. Emergencies & Crisis Situations

JUM is not equipped to respond to emergencies or crisis situations, including situations involving risk to your safety or someone else's. If you are experiencing an emergency, please contact your local emergency services or a crisis helpline immediately. JUM listeners are not trained crisis responders.

10. Payments & Pricing

Prices are shown in Indian Rupees (₹) at the time of booking and must be paid in full before your joining details are sent. Payments are processed through a third-party payment gateway; JUM does not store your full card or bank details.

11. Cancellations, Rescheduling & Refunds

Cancellations, rescheduling requests, and refunds are handled under JUM's separate Refund / Cancellation / Rescheduling Policy, which forms part of these Terms.

12. Technical Issues & Dropped Calls

If a session ends early due to a technical problem outside anyone's control (for example, a dropped call), JUM can issue a fresh joining link so you can resume the same session — this is limited to one callback per session, to prevent misuse. JUM is not responsible for issues caused by your internet connection, device, or the third-party calling platform you selected.

13. Your Content

Anything you choose to share during a session — your stories, thoughts, and experiences — remains yours. JUM does not claim ownership of what you share, and will not publish or reuse it without your explicit permission, except as required for the safety and legal exceptions described above.

14. Third-Party Services

Booking, payment, and calling functionality may rely on third-party services (such as payment processors and calling platforms). JUM is not responsible for outages, errors, or policies of those third-party services, though we will do our reasonable best to help resolve issues that affect your session.

15. Disclaimers

JUM is provided on an "as available" basis. We do not guarantee that a listener will be available at every requested time, that sessions will be free of interruption, or that any particular outcome will result from a session. See our separate Disclaimer for more detail.

16. Limitation of Liability

To the fullest extent permitted by law, JUM's liability for any claim arising from your use of the service is limited to the amount you paid for the session in question. JUM is not liable for indirect or consequential losses.

17. Suspension & Termination

JUM may decline, suspend, or cancel a booking — including for reasons of safety, abuse, or misuse of the service — with a refund handled according to the circumstances.

18. Changes to These Terms

We may update these Terms from time to time. Continuing to use JUM after changes are posted means you accept the updated Terms.

19. Governing Law

These Terms are governed by the laws of India, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.

20. Contact Us

Questions about these Terms can be sent to hello@justuandme.in.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body:
1. What We Collect

When you book a session, we collect the nickname or name you provide, your email address, and — if you choose to share it — a phone number. We also collect your chosen session date, time, duration, and calling platform, and any notes you optionally add for the listener. If you contact us directly, we keep a record of that correspondence.

2. Payment Information

Payments are processed by a third-party payment gateway. JUM does not receive or store your full card number, UPI PIN, or netbanking credentials — only confirmation that payment was successful.

3. Session Content

JUM does not intentionally record standard listening sessions. What you say during a session is not stored as data by JUM beyond the session itself, except for any notes you choose to submit when booking.

4. How We Use Your Information

We use the information you provide to confirm your booking, send joining details, process payment, respond to support requests, and — if something goes wrong technically — send a callback link to resume a dropped session. We may also use it to improve the service.

5. Who We Share It With

We share the minimum necessary information with the payment gateway (to process payment) and, if you choose a third-party calling platform, with that platform (to generate your joining link). We do not sell your personal information to anyone.

6. Data Retention

We keep booking and contact information only for as long as needed to deliver your session and handle any related support, refund, or legal request. Whether you booked using a nickname or your real details, all booking and contact information is automatically deleted no later than 6 months after your session, unless we are required to keep it longer to meet a legal or accounting obligation, or to resolve an active dispute.

7. Your Rights

You can ask us to access, correct, or delete the personal information we hold about you by emailing hello@justuandme.in. We will respond within a reasonable time.

8. Security

We take reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect your information, though no method of storage or transmission over the internet is completely secure.

9. Children

JUM is intended for adults aged 18 and above and is not directed at children. We do not knowingly collect information from anyone under 18.

10. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The current version will always be available on this page.

11. Contact Us

For any privacy-related question or request, email hello@justuandme.in.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.body:
Not Medical, Mental-Health, or Professional Care

JUM is a listening service. It is not medical care, mental-health therapy or counselling, nutrition or clinical advice, legal or business advice, relationship or political advice, or emergency or crisis care. Nothing shared or discussed during a JUM session should be treated as professional advice of any kind.

No Guaranteed Outcome

JUM does not promise any particular result, feeling, or outcome from a session. Every conversation is different, and how helpful a session feels can vary from person to person and session to session.

Listeners Are Not Licensed Clinicians

JUM listeners are trained to listen attentively and without judgement, but they are not licensed therapists, counsellors, doctors, or crisis responders unless separately and explicitly stated. If you need professional medical or mental-health support, please consult a qualified professional.

Not for Emergencies

If you are in crisis or believe you or someone else may be in danger, JUM is not the right resource. Please contact your local emergency services or a crisis helpline immediately.

Third-Party Platforms

Sessions may take place over third-party calling platforms (such as Google Meet, Zoom, or Microsoft Teams) or JUM's own calling tool. JUM cannot guarantee the uninterrupted availability of any of these platforms.

Your Choice

Using JUM is a personal, voluntary choice. You decide what to share and how much to say in every session.

refund.title: Refund / Cancellation / Rescheduling Policy
refund.body:
Cancellations

If you cancel more than 24 hours before your session, you receive a 100% refund. Between 12 and 24 hours before your session, you receive a 50% refund. Between 6 and 12 hours before, you receive a 25% refund. Cancelling less than 6 hours before your session, or not attending, is not normally eligible for a refund.

Rescheduling

You may request to reschedule a confirmed session to a different available date or time, subject to availability. We recommend requesting a reschedule as early as possible — the same time windows above apply if you cancel instead of rescheduling.

If JUM Cannot Confirm Your Session

If JUM is unable to confirm your requested slot, or a confirmed session cannot go ahead for reasons on JUM's side, you will receive a full refund and priority in rebooking a new time.

Dropped or Interrupted Sessions

If a session ends early due to a technical problem outside anyone's control, JUM can issue one fresh joining link so you can resume the same session at no extra cost. This callback option is limited to once per session.

Mid-Call Extensions

Extensions purchased during a live call (available only when using JUM's own calling tool) are charged separately at the time of the extension and are not covered by the cancellation refund tiers above, since the extended time has already been used.

How Refunds Are Paid

Approved refunds are returned through your original payment method wherever possible, and are typically processed within a reasonable number of business days.

One Listener, One Time Slot

Once a session is confirmed, that date and time is reserved exclusively for you. JUM does not allow two customers to hold a confirmed booking for the same slot.

Payment Problems

You will never be charged twice for the same session. If a payment appears to fail, or you are not sure whether it went through, contact us before trying again and we will confirm the status first.
